concept.title: Example: How dvrResourcePrefix and dvrResourceSuffix interact with resourceid
concept.shortdesc: In this scenario, a ditavalref element uses the nested dvrResourcePrefix and dvrResourceSuffix elements to resource IDs specified using resourceid.

conbody.p: The following code sample shows a simple branch with a parent and child topic, where the map branch uses dvrResourcePrefix to manage resource names. In this case the child topic also specifies a deliverable anchor with resourceid.<topicref href="branch-01.dita"> <ditavalref href="condition-01.ditaval"> <ditavalmeta> <dvrResourcePrefix>cond01-</dvrResourcePrefix> </ditavalmeta> </ditavalref> <topicref href="topics/subtopic-01.dita"> <topicmeta> <resourceid appid="ae35-unit-fault" appid-role="deliverable-anchor"/> </topicmeta> </topicref> </topicref>

After the ditavalref is evaluated:
The effective file name of resource branch-01.dita is cond01-branch-01.dita.
The effective file name of the resource topics/subtopic-01.dita is topics/cond01-subtopic-01.dita.
The effective value of appid on resourceid for the child topic is cond01-ae35-unit-fault.

The same concept applies when using dvrResourceSuffix. The map in this case uses the same structure as above, but uses dvrResourceSuffix to modify resource names:<topicref href="branch-01.dita"> <ditavalref href="condition-01.ditaval"> <ditavalmeta> <dvrResourceSuffix>-cond01</dvrResourceSuffix> </ditavalmeta> </ditavalref> <topicref href="topics/subtopic-01.dita"> <topicmeta> <resourceid appid="ae35-unit-fault" appid-role="deliverable-anchor"/> </topicmeta> </topicref> </topicref>

After the ditavalref is evaluated:
The effective file name of resource branch-01.dita is branch-01-cond01.dita.
The effective file name of the resource topics/subtopic-01.dita is topics/subtopic-01-cond01.dita.
The effective value of appid on resourceid for the child topic is ae35-unit-fault-cond01.
